body:
P2-25 DESIGN, part 7: review corrections (the advisor read the design and found four gaps; all four are in docs/tasks/P2-songs-as-references.md part 7, part 10 and part 15).

1. THE PLACEHOLDER ARTIST. refs.find returns nothing for [Unknown Artist] on purpose (is_unknown_artist), so in the rehome "find did not return this ref" would have MOVED a correct untagged file off its own song and made a new ref. Rule: tags whose artist is the placeholder are judged by IDS only; when no id names another ref the file STAYS. A suspect ref can carry the placeholder artist and an Arabic title, so the case is real; slice 4 test row: an untagged Arabic file stays on its ref.
2. THE TATWEEL. survives_fold_whole said "none may become none", but step 4 removes the tatweel (category Lm, a letter) on purpose. The rule now says "every letter, digit and kept mark that the table does not remove on purpose"; a fixture row: an Arabic name with a tatweel (era 0 false like every Arabic name, era 1 true).
3. STORED DATA THE BROKEN FOLD MADE. cover_finder stored Deezer covers of name matches (one hit matched every Arabic song; by_album copied one URL across every Arabic album of a pass) and only asks again when cover_url IS NULL. In the rekey transaction: a SUSPECT ref whose cover_url is on dzcdn.net or deezer.com and whose deezer_id is NULL gets cover_url and cover_tried_at cleared (touch_file and touch_ref_holders), and the finder asks again with the new fold, paced. A ref with a deezer_id and every Latin ref keep theirs. artist_finder is guarded (pick_artist_picture returns nothing when either folded name is empty, artist_finder.py:91): its failures were misses, retried after 7 days (RETRY_AFTER_MS), nothing to void. NOT recoverable by the server: the picture already written into kept files and the cover.jpg written into album folders (_folder_picture leaves an existing one alone); the retag machinery of N-34 and N-26 slice 5 takes the corrected cover from the ref, or the Host deletes a wrong cover.jpg.
4. THE PYTHON THAT MAKES THE TABLE. server.yml runs Python 3.12 and the image is python:3.12-slim (Unicode 15.0.0 by Python documentation, not run here); this machine runs 3.13.14 (15.1.0). tools/gen_text_fold_table.py refuses to write or to check unless unicodedata.unidata_version equals the version named in the committed table, the fixture header and textnorm.py; the corpus lists only code points assigned in that version; plus the corpus test of RESULTS.
ACCEPTED RISK added: the rehome compares lengths within 3 s through find; a ref whose duration_ms was filled by a later description after its file was attached can split a correct pair (a duplicate, the safe direction).
CORRECTIONS TO THE BRIEF: P2-12 slices 5, 6 and 8 need P2-25 (not 3 and 5); the N-34 skip rule is "survives the fold whole" (the advisor ruling), not "the key is empty"; the rekey is a Python start-up repair and the migration only adds the worklist table and the ref_merge columns; N-34 and the order: this PR does not touch order.json for N-34.
